method: paired frame-interleaved, arm-first alternating by frame parity

validity.cache_hit_counter_bug: The original hits counter incremented when the cache was non-empty BEFORE clearing, i.e. left over from the previous frame. The cache is cleared immediately before every call, so no call was ever served from it. The detector cost 252-354 ms/frame in every run, which is real inference; a served cache hit is microseconds. The counter was measuring staleness, not reuse.
